Name: Animated Villagers Craftables
Author: deleted107871763
Description:
[center][b][size=3][/size][/b][/center][center][size=3][b]===

-Introduction-[/b]
[b]﻿You already have your wife or husband by your side, but do you want more villagers living on your farm?[/b]
[b]It can be achieved by a simple trick of turning some craftables into animated villagers' characters.
[/b][b]With this mod, some "NPCs" can be placed anywhere, and i guess they will enjoy their "lives".

[/b][b]-Installation-
[/b][b]1. Install the latest version of all the required mods.
[/b][b]2. Unzip the mod folder into your game mods folder (Stardew Valley/Mods).
[/b][b]3. Run your game with SMAPI.﻿

[/b][b]-Don't want specific retextures?-
[/b][b]In the 1.1 version, [/b][b]you can choose whether to retexture specific craftables by changing true/false in the config file.[/b]
[b]The name of options is the description of the preview image.
[/b][b]Use [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][b]﻿ to make it easier to change in-game.[/b]

[b]-Notes-
[/b][b]1. This mod is Inspired by [url=https://blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222043222889]GH‘s Craftables retexture[/url]﻿, it's really creative and beautiful work.
[/b][b]2. Used mods in the preview images:
[/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6742]Alvadea's Flowergrass and Snowfields[/url],
[/b][b]﻿[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6942]cometkins's Better Resources[/url]﻿,

[/b][b]DustBeauty's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5444]Industrial Furniture Set[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4852]Seasonal Path and Flooring[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Stardew Foliage Redone[/url]﻿﻿,
[/b][b]Delotti's [url=https://blog.naver.com/sxdcdc/222775585540]POTION[/url]﻿ and [url=https://blog.naver.com/sxdcdc/222701165486]ROSE[/url]﻿,
